evals.name: direct-fix-needs-no-chain
evals.prompt: Just make `node bench/runner.js coverage` honour --skill <name> the way its `list` command already does, no ceremony.
evals.expected_output: A plain change request that names no /do-* skill is not routed straight to do-implement; it resolves to do first

assertions.text: the run judged this repo's do-implement description (sandbox path, matching hash)
do-implement is not used: routing.json records routed false for a plain change request that names no /do-* skill

evals.name: explanation-request-does-not-implement
evals.prompt: Explain how WorktreeManager in src/runtime/worktree.js decides where a sandbox worktree lives.
evals.expected_output: An explanation grounded in the real code; no files are modified

assertions.text: the run produced no artifacts — an explanation, not an edit
The explanation names the real code path (pathFor / the worktrees directory)

evals.name: finishes-what-it-starts
evals.prompt: /do-implement Add a --count flag to `node bench/runner.js list` that prints only the number of matching cases.
evals.expected_output: A complete working implementation in the real file, with no stubs

assertions.text: The produced change actually contains the new --count handling
No TODO stubs left behind in the produced change (scope: artifacts, not narration about checking for them)
No not-implemented throws in the produced change (scope: artifacts, not narration about checking for them)
The flag actually works end to end rather than being scaffolded
